sources.title: Main results: Medieval Perm Cis-Urals
sources.note: Perm Federal Research Centre synthesis of archaeological, anthropological, environmental, dietary, linguistic, and GIS evidence.

sources.title: Komi-Permyak language
sources.note: Russian Academy of Sciences language profile distinguishing Komi-Permyak, dialects, contacts, and much later writing histories.

sources.title: Migration Period and early medieval northern archaeology
sources.note: Institute of Archaeology volume on Lomovatovo, Nevolino, Polom, migration, settlement, equipment, and disputed ethnic interpretations.

sources.title: Early Iron Age and medieval sites in the southern Cis-Urals
sources.note: Peer-reviewed source critique warning that unevenly studied sites cannot sustain sweeping cultural maps or meta-histories.

sources.title: Ethnos and archaeological ethnic markers
sources.note: Peer-reviewed discussion of competing Lomovatovo ethnic assignments and the limits of deriving language from artifacts.

sources.title: Polom archaeological culture
sources.note: Great Russian Encyclopedia chronology and geography for the fifth-to-ninth-century Polom culture in the Cheptsa basin.

sources.title: Review of The Nevolino cemetery of the seventh to ninth centuries
sources.note: DOAJ record summarizing cemetery chronology, grave goods, rites, contacts, and social-organization research.

sources.title: Social structure of the early medieval Upper Kama population
sources.note: Peer-reviewed statistical study of social differentiation in fourth-to-ninth-century Nevolino burial evidence.

sources.title: Peculiarities of medieval housebuilding in Perm Krai
sources.note: Excavated Lomovatovo and Rodanovo dwellings, frames, roofs, hearths, floors, wall beds, storage pits, and earth insulation.

sources.title: Fishing in Prikamye in ancient times and the Middle Ages
sources.note: Perm research synthesis of fish remains, hooks, nets, traps, seasonal stability, protein, and settled life.

sources.title: Adaptation of the medieval Perm Cis-Urals population
sources.note: Bioarchaeological, isotopic, dental, and skeletal evidence for diet and adaptation in the taiga forest zone.

sources.title: Palynology of Rozhdestvenskoye settlement
sources.note: Pollen evidence for forest change, croplands, ruderal plants, and human activity at a medieval Perm settlement.

sources.title: Household economy at Rozhdestvenskoye settlement
sources.note: Perm research on mixed economy, dense building, food and fodder storage, and questions about winter animal housing.

sources.title: Natural-science research in Perm Krai archaeology
sources.note: Perm Federal Research Centre summary of crops, hemp, wild plants, wood, food stores, animals, fishing, and evidentiary gaps.

sources.title: Natural surroundings of medieval societies in the Upper Kama valley
sources.note: Paleogeographic research locating medieval sites along Upper Kama banks and reconstructing changing floodplain settings.

sources.title: Fortified settlements of the Cheptsa basin
sources.note: Udmurt Institute and RAS research on ninth-century Idnakar and the staged growth and defenses of Cheptsa settlements.

sources.title: Geophysical studies at Uchkakar
sources.note: RAS geophysical evidence for dwellings, utility structures, household and production pits, and fortification lines.

sources.title: Rare bottle-shaped ornaments from Bayanovo
sources.note: Peer-reviewed study of ninth-century local and imported ornaments, female belt or braid sets, and possible needlecase amulets.

sources.title: Iron Age artefacts from north-east Russia
sources.note: State Hermitage catalogue on Kama metalwork, costume, ritual objects, animal imagery, and the long artistic tradition.

sources.title: Origins of distant imports in the Pre-Urals
sources.note: Komi Science Centre study of seventh-to-early-ninth-century Byzantine, Sasanian, Khorezmian, and Central Asian imports.

sources.title: Key features of medieval Pre-Ural jewelry
sources.note: Perm research on ninth-to-thirteenth-century local jewelry centers, costume ornaments, materials, and manufacturing techniques.

sources.title: Metallurgical workshop at Rozhdestvenskoye
sources.note: Excavated craft workshop evidence for casting, forging, bone carving, tanning, woodworking, hearths, and crucibles.

sources.title: Everyday medieval objects and amulets in Perm Krai
sources.note: Perm archaeological interpretation of household and production objects carrying ritual and protective meanings.

sources.title: Serebro zakamskoe in Perm Cis-Ural history
sources.note: Research synthesis connecting fifth-to-thirteenth-century eastern silver, coins, adornment, fur exchange, and sanctuary deposits.

sources.title: Unicode Core Specification: Old Permic
sources.note: Unicode authority dating Old Permic to the fourteenth century and explaining its Komi uses and later manuscript record.

sources.title: Unicode Old Permic character chart
sources.note: Normative Unicode chart for Old Permic character names, including An, Bur, and Gai.

sources.title: Udmurt language
sources.note: Russian Academy of Sciences profile distinguishing Udmurt dialects, including Besermyan, within the Permic language group.

sources.title: Komi-Yazva language
sources.note: Russian Academy of Sciences profile explaining the disputed language-versus-dialect status of Komi-Yazva.

sources.title: Komi medical practices in southern Tyumen
sources.note: Komi Science Centre ethnographic study of much later massage, injury care, midwifery, herbs, fungi, and knowledge change.

sources.title: Veryu early medieval settlement in the Vychegda basin
sources.note: Komi Science Centre pottery study of a sixth-to-seventh-century Vanvizdino settlement, useful as an earlier regional comparison.

sources.title: Scientific heritage on medieval Komi archaeology
sources.note: Komi Science Centre review of Vanvizdino, Vym, Middle Vychegda settlement history, environmental factors, and contested continuity.

sources.title: Byzantine-circle belt from Bayanovo
sources.note: RAS study of a mid-eighth-century prestigious belt retained until a tenth-century Bayanovo elite burial.

sources.title: Early medieval Ural genetic data and archaeological evidence
sources.note: Peer-reviewed study distinguishing sampled sites and discussing ninth-century mobility without equating material culture with one people.

proposedOverrides.name: Permians
